verdict.rationale: Zep automatically ingests raw chat messages into a Context Graph on every thread.add_messages call, extracting entities/edges/facts without explicit developer specification (zep-docs-20, zep-docs-27, zep-docs-48), and continuously maintains incremental thread summaries and temporal fact invalidation via Graphiti in the background (zep-docs-8, zep-docs-52, zep-gh-1). Community discussion corroborates the underlying design rationale — Zep pivoted to graph-based extraction specifically to improve automatic fact reconciliation across complex conversations (zep-comm-1) — though general skepticism about memory-system hallucination exists in the wild (zep-comm-6). Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks validating extraction accuracy/salience decisions, and detail on consolidation scheduling/frequency.
